Text.Text: I am Karrav Maubar. I buy, I sell, and I outfit every caravan that leaves Anchorhead. I pay fairly and on time, and I expect fair work in return.
It is always a fair trade with me. Here is your payment for the teeth and the claws.
These are clean and free of rot, and the Jawas are particular about rot. Shall we settle your payment?

A Jawa clan I trade with sets womprat teeth and claws into the grips of their tools, and they pay me in salvage. I need you to bring me six Womprat Teeth and six Womprat Claws from the Womprats around Anchorhead. Bring them to me here in the South District and I will pay you fairly.
Good. Collect six Womprat Teeth and six Womprat Claws from any Womprats you find outside town, then bring them to me here in the South District.
The hunters skin a Womprat for its hide and leave the rest on the sand. I have asked them to bring the teeth and claws, and they looked at me as though I were mad.
I still need six Womprat Teeth and six Womprat Claws. Any Womprat outside town will do. Bring them to me here, because the Jawas do not wait quietly.
Here is your payment. The cook also sent these pot pies across for you. They are Sand Demon, not Sandswimmer, so you may relax.
These are fresh enough that the cook will have nothing to complain about, though he will try. Shall we settle your payment?

I supply the cantina, and the cook there wants Sandswimmer. He needs fins for a soup he claims is a delicacy somewhere, and legs for the stock. I need you to bring me six Sandswimmer Fins and four Sandswimmer Legs. Bring them to me here in the South District and I will pay you.
Good. Collect six Sandswimmer Fins and four Sandswimmer Legs from the Sandswimmers on the Desert Road or the Flatlands, then bring them to me here in the South District.
Perhaps it is on a world that has water. Here on Tatooine it is simply the meat that is available, and the cook makes the best of it.
I still need six Sandswimmer Fins and four Sandswimmer Legs for the cantina kitchen. Sandswimmers hunt the Desert Road and the Flatlands. Bring them to me here.
Then my drivers will go out tomorrow, and that is worth every credit of this. Count your payment if you wish. It will be right.
Those are four large claws, and I will nail them to the caravan post where every driver can see. Did you kill all eight Sand Demons?

Sand Demons killed two of my banthas and a driver in the North Hills last week, and my drivers will not go out. I need you to kill eight Sand Demons and bring me four Sand Demon Claws, so I can show the drivers it was done. Come back to me here and I will pay you well.
Good. Kill eight Sand Demons in the North Hills, the Flatlands or the Northern Dunes, and bring four Sand Demon Claws back to me here in the South District.
Mostly in the North Hills, but also in the Flatlands and the Northern Dunes. They wait under the sand along the caravan lines.
One killed a bantha in the time it took the driver to turn around. Go well armed, and do not expect them to be slow.
I still need eight Sand Demons killed and four Sand Demon Claws brought to me. They hunt the North Hills, the Flatlands and the Northern Dunes. Come back here when you have both.
Here is your payment. I will also keep one canteen back for you, for the next time you cross the dunes.
These are good hides with barely a mark on them. You are improving. Shall we settle your payment?

Sand Demon hide does not sweat and does not crack, so a canteen sewn from it loses nothing in a week of sun. Caravan masters pay three times the price of plastoid for one. I need you to bring me five Sand Demon Hides. Bring them to me here in the South District and I will pay you well.
Good. Collect five whole Sand Demon Hides from the Sand Demons in the North Hills, the Flatlands or the Northern Dunes, then bring them to me here in the South District.
A caravan master will pay anything for water that is still there on the sixth day. At three times the price I am being generous.
I still need five Sand Demon Hides. Sand Demons hunt the North Hills, the Flatlands and the Northern Dunes. Bring all five hides to me here.
Here is the sweep rate, as agreed. The offer stands whenever you want to run another sweep.
You are back, and the drivers say the line was quiet. Did you kill ten Sand Demons and ten Sand Beetles?

I pay a fixed rate for every sweep of the caravan lines, and the work is always open. For one sweep I need you to kill ten Sand Demons and ten Sand Beetles out in the desert. Come back to me here each time it is done and I will pay you the rate.
Good. Kill ten Sand Demons and ten Sand Beetles along the caravan lines, then come back to me here in the South District for the sweep rate.
A sweep is ten Sand Demons and ten Sand Beetles killed. Come back to me here when all twenty are dead and I will pay the sweep rate.
Goodbye, Karrav. Fair dealing to you.
What else are you buying or paying for?
Yes. I hope it's a fair trade.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll bring you six teeth and six claws.
Not right now. The Womprats can keep their teeth.
Why don't you buy them from the hunters?
Are you buying womprat teeth and claws?
Here are six Womprat Teeth and six Womprat Claws.
I don't have them all yet.
Remind me what you need from the Womprats.
Yes. Tell him to enjoy his soup.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll fill the order. Six fins and four legs.
Not right now. I'm no cook's errand runner.
Is Sandswimmer soup really a delicacy?
Do you need supplies for the cantina kitchen?
Here are six Sandswimmer Fins and four Sandswimmer Legs.
I'm still hunting. I'll come back.
Remind me what the cantina kitchen ordered.
Yes, all eight Sand Demons are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. Eight Sand Demons and four claws.
Not right now. That's too dangerous for me.
Where do the Sand Demons hunt?
How dangerous are they?
What is attacking your caravans?
Here are the four Sand Demon Claws.
I'm still hunting. I'll come back.
Remind me what you need done about the Sand Demons.
Yes. Go ahead and sew your canteens.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll bring you five Sand Demon Hides.
Not right now. I've had enough of Sand Demons.
Do they really pay three times the price?
Do you have a use for Sand Demon hides?
Here are the five Sand Demon Hides.
I don't have them all yet.
Remind me how many Sand Demon Hides you need.
Yes, I killed ten of each.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll run a sweep. Ten Sand Demons and ten Sand Beetles.
Not right now. Maybe another time.
Do you pay for clearing the caravan lines?
Still working on it.
Remind me what a sweep of the caravan lines needs.
